ma.createSelectorQuery()

Return a SelectorQuery object instance.

Return Value

SelectorQuery

Sample Code

const query = ma.createSelectorQuery()
query.select('#the-id').boundingClientRect()
query.selectViewport().scrollOffset()
query.exec(function(res){
  res[0].top       // #Coordinates of the upper boundary of the the-id node.
  res[1].scrollTop // Vertical scrolling position of the display area.
})
